grade.basis: Independent reading of every music page of No.3 (PDF pages 5–8). Cello 1 leads with exposed tenor-register cantabile and higher excursions, chromatic slurred turns, dotted/semiquaver and triplet figures, changing tenor/treble clefs, and harmonics near rehearsal 9. Rehearsals 2–5 and 7–8 require precise expressive shifts and chromatic intonation; parts 2–4 add double stops, chordal passages, active soft accompaniment, and coordination of triplets against other subdivisions. Semplice ed intimo quarter=60 and a tempo quarter=69 keep running notes moderate. The long quiet phrases, ppp/pppp dynamics, senza vibrato opening and muted close make bow control and sustained tuning consequential. Whole-piece pre-diploma level6 is appropriate for its exposed upper-register control and expressive technique; it does not call for fast virtuoso passagework. No automatic ensemble uplift is added. The grade covers only the complete independent No.3, not all Preghiere.
